entries.purpose: Research ECL lifecycle entries, code bases, typed memory, selector tables, VM instruction behavior and DAX index semantics; cross-check graphics headers, shared/additional tile ordering, bank continuation, transparency and native perspective geometry; cross-check PIC first-frame XOR semantics and per-frame metadata; research picture/sprite host calls, clearing, distance selection and unsupported timed replacement; cross-check COLOR backdrop addresses, indoor selector, sky palette indices and native band geometry; cross-check original font selection, SSI printable character order and foreground recoloring; cross-check opaque BODY/HEAD composition, embedded offsets and explicit fallback placement; research LOAD_AREA_DECO argument order and graphics rebinding; profile-driven PICTURE head/body selection; research three-operand LOAD_AREA_MAP dungeon/retain modes and separation from NEW_ECL; cross-check three-operand dungeon map requests, retained-map modes and distinction from NEW_ECL; cross-check ClassicMode fixed 400 ms picture scheduling and RendererState frame wrapping; research Pool title ordering (1,2), final-title menu backdrop and separation of mode/program menus from game startup; cross-check centered title placement independent of EGA metadata offsets against TitleRenderer; research character creation stages, standard race/class choices, class alignments, 4d6 drop-lowest reroll behavior and separation of standard/Krynn/Buck Rogers rules; research LOAD_CHAR selection, character virtual-memory window, name lookup and ordinary/exceptional ability offsets; research WHO party prompt, SELECT action/resumption and distinction between loaded-character and selected-PC state; research script-facing readiness versus native character status ordinals; cross-check AND zero/nonzero comparison flags used by original event branches; corroborate original gold record field during independent native HP and money research; inspect empty SOUND_EVENT handlers before audio implementation; compare generic CALL metadata with the independently verified Pool sound-call route; corroborate original five-second title waits with ClassicMode.showNextTitle; research initial campaign program zero, NEW_ECL lifecycle order, ADD, DELAY and nearest-sprite replacement Navigation clearing and Down-as-turnaround conventions were independently implemented after consulting DungeonMovementHandler, Engine and ClassicMode; synthetic pixel tests do not establish original timing parity. Movement lifecycle research consulted DungeonMovementHandler, DungeonMap and Pool properties: exit-attempt 0x6DD5 and movement-block 0x6DC9. Native flag preparation and an opening boundary transition were checked separately; engine movement lifecycle parity remains unfinished. Source-cell movement and program-transfer ordering, temporary no-resource area mode, forced-step CALL were researched in the pinned Engine, VirtualMachine, DungeonMovementHandler and Pool configuration. Native boundary/source-edge and forced-step routines were independently probed with synthetic buffers. Pool properties explicitly assign opcode 0x1D to PARTY_STRENGTH, with one operand; the pinned VM handler is empty. No Return-input meaning or party-strength calculation was adopted. Cross-check VirtualMemory.clearTemps against the complete original Pool interpreter reset and its one-shot preserve guard. Corroborate PARTY_STRENGTH input labels using Pool CharacterValues and confirm the upstream opcode handler is empty; formula verified independently against original code. Corroborate supported class-level offsets; original creator initialization independently verified for 17 native class codes. Check empty PARTY_STRENGTH and THAC0 placeholders before independently verifying original unequipped combat initialization and rating arithmetic. Consult Engine, EngineConfiguration and Pool resource-family configuration before independently verifying native graphics group selection. Cross-check AbstractStateRenderer word wrapping during native boundary dialogue comparison; its strict overflow check differs from the observed native exact-fit boundary. Evaluate existing position, search and movement abstractions before independently probing the native position/clock formatter. Compare arithmetic opcode metadata and remainder policy before independently probing the native shared arithmetic handler in 30 cases. Compare Pool opcode22 metadata and class-code labels before independently probing all 256 native class codes and linked parties.

entries.purpose: SSI EGA single-image and multi-frame packed-pixel decoding plus monochrome 8x8 tile strips
entries.modifications: Adapted C# decoding to bounded C++ indexed images. Exact payload/dimension/count checks; retain CGA mapping and offsets; no System.Drawing, filename-dependent palette guessing or count-plus-one heuristic. Wall assembly, bank loading and EGA bit-derived palette are independent additions in the same MIT file. No SSI images copied. Added explicit independent/XOR-first sequence modes, immutable base-frame decoding, raw timing/offset/header metadata, exact consumption, dimension/count limits and explicit standard/sprite/combat palettes. Mono bits become indexed black/white tiles; no filename-based format selection or partial decode results. Independent bounded portrait composition added beside the adapted decoder; no upstream portrait compositor copied.
